description: Type the thought. Get the verse. Say it.
notes: Copied from the winning ad 'you cant fight a thought silently' (ad 120247236178540227, creative 1108174568373599). Thought categories and counts are from the Take It Captive feature (guard_thought_rejected), last 30 days.

ads.name: PAIN-01 not enough (inadequacy)
ads.headline: A verse for every “not enough” day
ads.message:
you can't fight the "not enough" thought silently and win. step 2 is the whole key.

1. name it. that's the accuser talking, not God.
2. find what God says about it.
3. say it out loud: "I am complete in Him." Colossians 2:10

you don't have to earn enough. in Him, you already are.

step 2 is where most people get stuck. right before the big moment, you don't know where to look.

so type the thought into SpeakLife. it hands you the verse to speak back at it.

try it free tonight 👇
